title.zh: 新加坡税务局（罪行构成）条例 2024
title.en: Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore (Composition of Offences) Regulations 2024

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore (Composition of Offences) Regulations 2024 and come into operation on 1 November 2024.
2. An offence under section 17F(1), (3) or (5), 17G(2)(a), 17H(13)(a), (15) or (19) or 17M(4) or (9) of the Act may be compounded by the Authority in accordance with section 28A of the Act.
